observations: Two photos show outdoor metal water tank towers with black plastic tanks on top.
The towers are made of metal scaffolding with diagonal bracing, painted white or galvanized.
One tower has a wooden platform; the other has a metal platform.
The towers are installed on residential properties with tiled roofs and walls.
The text 'STAINLESSWAY CONSTRUCTION' is watermarked on both photos.
Photo 1 shows a thatched-roof gazebo in the foreground and construction debris on the ground.
No visible brand or model markings on the towers or tanks.
The seller's text mentions services: installation of stainless handrail, glass work, wrought iron — not the towers shown.

claims.claim: stainless handrail, glass work, wrought iron installation services
claims.evidence: The photos show water tank towers, not handrails, glass work, or wrought iron. The seller's text does not match the photos.
The watermark 'STAINLESSWAY CONSTRUCTION' appears on both photos.

risks.proof: Close-up of the tanks and their mounting brackets

response.reason: The photos show metal water tank towers, but the seller's text refers to unrelated services. The material (stainless vs galvanized) and structural condition are not verifiable from current photos, which are critical for pricing. More proof is needed to assess quality and safety.
